en.headline: Red flags raised at Big Wave Bay and Ting Kau beaches
en.dek: The Leisure and Cultural Services Department said water quality is forecast as very poor at the two beaches due to possible fluctuations after heavy rain.
body: Red flags have been hoisted at Big Wave Bay Beach on Hong Kong Island and Ting Kau Beach in Tsuen Wan, the Leisure and Cultural Services Department announced on Saturday.

According to the Environmental Protection Department’s Beach Water Quality Forecast System, the index for both beaches stands at 4, meaning predicted water quality is very poor because of potential transient fluctuations caused by heavy rain.
Beachgoers are advised not to enter the water to safeguard their health.

zh.headline: 大浪灣及汀九泳灘懸掛紅旗
zh.dek: 康文署表示兩處泳灘水質預測指數為4屬非常差，因大雨可能導致短暫水質波動。
body: 康樂及文化事務署今日宣布，香港島大浪灣泳灘及荃灣汀九泳灘已懸掛紅旗。
根據環境保護署泳灘水質預測系統，兩處泳灘的水質預測指數為4，表示預測水質非常差，因大雨可能引起短暫水質波動。
泳客切勿下水，以保障健康。
